w10_T4_000941: Early on Monday morning a harbour crew found 68 crab pots stacked on the quay. 40 of them had rotten netting and were taken away to be mended. Before lunch each of the remaining pots was fitted with 3 bait bags. In the afternoon every one of those bags was filled with 6 sardines. That evening a fisherman tipped in 29 spare sardines that were left in his bucket. How many sardines did the crew use in total?
w10_T4_000942: Farah lays tiles more quickly than her workmate Gustav does. She unloaded 4 crates of floor tiles, with 148 tiles in every crate. Each of those tiles was cut into 6 small mosaic pieces. The pieces were then shared out equally between the 4 rooms of the house, and Gustav carried one room's share upstairs. The house has 9 windows, and half of its walls are already painted. The client has now ordered 6 more houses done to the same standard, each needing as many pieces as that one room's share. How many mosaic pieces will the 6 houses need in total?
w10_T4_000949: On Saturday morning Elif counted 108 bunches of flowers in the market van, and her colleague Hugo added 67 bunches he had cut at dawn, though Elif always cuts more than Hugo does. Before noon the wholesaler asked for 4 vans to be loaded with the same number of bunches as this one, and all of them were filled. The market square has 32 stalls. In the afternoon a grower dropped off 58 extra bunches. By the evening 481 bunches had been sold across the vans. How many bunches were left unsold?
w10_T4_000958: Isla and her brother Ronan keep their holiday savings in one tin, and Isla puts in more than Ronan does. They record the tin in whole dollars rather than in cents. The tin held 14 dollars in April, and 7 dollars were spent on a bus ticket. In May Isla added 75 dollars from her weekend job, and in June 34 dollars went on a birthday present. Their grandmother then made the tin worth 9 times as much as it held. Half of the money in the tin was later moved into a savings account. How many dollars are left in the tin?
w10_T4_000962: In the morning a stadium caterer laid out 8 trolleys, each carrying 83 boxed lunches. By midday that same number of boxed lunches had been prepared for each of the 9 gates around the ground. In the afternoon the organisers doubled the whole order because a second match was added to the day. That evening a driver found 17 more boxed lunches in his van and added them to the total. How many boxed lunches were prepared altogether?
w10_T4_000963: The cupboard in the office at Fern Road School is the only place the pens are kept. At the start of term the cupboard held 38 pens, and the secretary added 66 pens from an old order. The head teacher then bought enough pens for the cupboard to hold 8 times as many as it did. A teacher returned 27 pens found in a classroom drawer. A parent later donated another 40 pens to the same cupboard. How many pens are in the cupboard now?
w10_T4_000974: A taxi firm records all of its driving time in minutes rather than in hours. On Monday morning each of its 6 drivers logged 176 minutes on the road. In the afternoon the firm doubled that total by sending out a second, identical shift. By the evening half of all the logged minutes had been thrown out because a meter fault made them worthless. The firm then repeated exactly the same day for 6 days running, and one driver added 10 minutes of overtime to the week's total. That same six-day week was repeated in each of the 5 weeks of the month. How many minutes does the firm's monthly record show?
w10_T4_000977: A launderette records its wash cycles in hours rather than in minutes. On Monday morning 4 machines were each loaded with 164 towels. Before lunch a hotel sent over 16 more towels for the same job. During the afternoon 335 towels were collected by their owners. In the evening head office asked all 6 of its branches to hold the same number of towels as this branch had left. How many towels do the 6 branches hold in total?
w10_T4_000979: The bread rack at Otto's bakery is the only place he keeps his loaves. Early on Friday morning the rack held 171 loaves, and the second oven added 34 more before opening time. A coach party's order was so large that Otto doubled the number of loaves on the rack by baking an identical batch. At midday an apprentice put 65 freshly baked loaves onto the rack. In the evening a delivery from the sister bakery added 75 loaves to the same rack. How many loaves are on the rack now?
w10_T4_000983: A hospital ward keeps all of its clean pillowcases in one linen store. On Monday morning the store held 127 pillowcases and the laundry delivered 65 more. During Monday's rounds 140 pillowcases were taken to the beds, and in the afternoon another 40 went to the day room. On Tuesday the laundry returned 55 washed pillowcases in the morning, and 65 were sent to the new wing in the afternoon. On Wednesday evening a porter found 18 clean pillowcases in a trolley and put them back in the store. How many pillowcases are in the linen store now?
w10_T4_000993: Mireille climbs more often than her partner Anton does. Their club owns 7 storage barrels, each holding 62 metres of rope. The club cut off 63 metres that had frayed and threw it away. A member donated 17 metres of good rope to the store. The club's practice wall is 12 metres high. A school course used 50 metres of the rope and an expedition took another 135 metres. How many metres of rope does the club have left?
w10_T4_000997: On Monday morning an orchard put 202 pears into the cold store, and by mid-morning 54 more had been picked and added. Before lunch the manager decided the store should hold 4 times as many pears, and enough were picked to make that happen. The orchard has 18 rows of trees. In the afternoon a neighbour brought 57 pears from her own garden, and 90 bruised pears were taken out and composted. In the evening head office asked each of its 9 orchards to fill a cold store with the same number of pears as this one. How many pears will the 9 orchards store altogether?
w10_T4_001001: A parcel depot took in 8 cages, each containing 105 parcels. The parcels were divided equally between 3 delivery rounds, and one driver loaded a single round's share into his van. The depot van park has 14 spaces. A late collection added 65 parcels to that driver's load. A load of that same size is now planned for each of the 8 drivers who work on Saturdays. How many parcels will the Saturday drivers carry in total?
w10_T4_001004: A museum keeps all of its unsold exhibition tickets in one drawer at the front desk. On Friday morning the drawer held 216 tickets, and the printer delivered 34 more before opening. At midday the director ordered enough identical batches for the drawer to hold 9 times as many tickets as it did. In the afternoon a school returned 25 unused tickets and a travel agent returned 32 more, all put back into the same drawer. The museum has 4 floors. By evening 602 tickets had been sold from the drawer. How many tickets are in the drawer now?
w10_T4_001008: A kite shop keeps its whole stock of kites on one wall. On Saturday morning the wall held 64 kites, and 62 of them were sold in the first hour of a very windy day. Before lunch the owner unpacked new stock so that the wall held 6 times as many kites as were left on it. In the afternoon a supplier's van brought 17 more kites for the same wall. That evening 21 kites were sold to a school. How many kites are on the wall now?
w10_T4_001024: Amina fills more crates at the dairy than her colleague Bertrand does, and the dairy records its output in litres rather than in millilitres. Each crate on Amina's line holds 117 bottles, and every trolley takes 5 crates. Each chilled lorry is loaded with 5 trolleys, and 7 lorries leave the dairy every day. The dairy yard has 20 loading bays. The dairy will run to that same plan on each of the 3 days of the bank holiday weekend. How many bottles will leave the dairy over those 3 days?
w10_T4_001032: Hana sews faster than her colleague Petro does, and their workshop records its sewing time in hours rather than in minutes. On Monday morning 7 rolls of fabric arrived, and each roll was cut into 108 squares. Before lunch the squares were shared equally between the 4 sewing tables, and Petro took one table's pile. In the afternoon the manager ordered 9 tables' worth of that same size for a hotel contract. That evening 1343 of those squares had already been sewn into quilts. How many squares are still waiting to be sewn?
w10_T4_001035: On Monday morning Dalia counted 229 pairs of shoes in her stockroom, which is bigger than the one her colleague Emre looks after. 6 pairs were water-damaged and were thrown out before the shop opened. In the afternoon a delivery van brought 27 more pairs into the stockroom. That evening head office asked for 8 branches to each hold as many pairs as Dalia's stockroom. The company then tripled that whole order to get ready for the sales. How many pairs of shoes does the company's order come to?
w10_T4_001037: Ravi weaves more cloth in a week than his cousin Sunita does. He started with 125 metres of thread and bought 27 metres more. The mill ordered 8 batches of exactly that length for the season. A supplier added 15 metres as a free sample. The mill then repeated the whole order for each of its 6 workshops. During the season 961 metres of thread were used up. How many metres of thread remain?
w10_T4_001038: A youth club keeps all of its footballs in one net bag. On Saturday morning the bag held 17 footballs, but 15 of them were too flat to use and were taken away. Before lunch a coach pumped up spares until the bag held 3 times as many balls as were left in it. The club's pitch is 90 metres long. In the afternoon a sports shop donated 28 footballs to the bag, and 13 balls were then lent to a neighbouring club. That evening the council promised the club 9 bags, each holding as many footballs as this one. How many footballs will the club have in the 9 bags?
w10_T4_001039: A cycle-hire depot records its journeys in whole hours rather than in minutes, and it keeps all of its helmets on one rack. The rack held 110 helmets in March, then 18 arrived from a depot that had closed and 73 were bought new. In April head office decided the rack should hold 9 times as many helmets and stocked it accordingly. The depot is open 7 days a week. In May 89 helmets were sent away to be cleaned and never came back. The city now wants 4 depots, each with a rack the same size as this one. How many helmets will the 4 depots need?
w10_T4_001045: A printing house stores all of its finished postcards in one crate. The first run put 8 bundles of 117 postcards into the crate. A second order was so large that the crate ended up holding 6 times as many postcards as the first run had put in it. A customer added 63 hand-printed cards to the same crate. Over the summer 4216 postcards were sold from the crate. A shop returned 16 unsold cards at the end of the season. How many postcards are in the crate now?
w10_T4_001047: A garden centre received 226 bags of bulbs and then doubled the order because spring came early. Each of those bags holds 4 bulbs. The centre's car park has 60 spaces. Over the planting weekend 809 bulbs were sold. A landscaper returned 55 bulbs he had not been able to plant. How many bulbs does the garden centre have now?
w10_T4_001055: Bella collects more scrap metal for the school project than her friend Theo does. The pile in the school yard started with 68 tin cans. Bella added 43 cans and Theo added 46 more to the same pile. The caretaker then arranged for the pile to grow to 6 times its size by bringing cans in from other schools. Half of the cans in the pile had already been washed. A local cafe finally tipped 76 more cans onto the pile. How many cans are in the pile now?
w10_T4_001056: A theatre sells its programmes in whole dollars rather than in cents. The box office printed 6 batches of 224 programmes for the season. A sponsor supplied 68 extra programmes. The theatre has 3 bars in the foyer. Over the run 800 programmes were sold and a further 112 were given away to school groups. How many programmes are left?
